body:
FreeTaxUSA is an online tax preparation service for United States federal and state returns, owned by TaxHawk, Inc. Filing a federal return costs nothing, and a state return carries a fee that review sites put at roughly US$15; an optional Deluxe upgrade of about US$8 adds live-chat support and audit help.

What is free and what is not

Reviewers describe the free tier as covering federal filing even for more complex situations, which is where some other tax-software brands begin to charge. State filing is billed per return. You are not asked to pay until you are ready to submit, and the software checks for deductions and credits as you answer interview-style questions.

The Deluxe upgrade

The Deluxe package adds live chat support, unlimited amendments and audit support. If you expect to need help or to amend a return, compare the cost of Deluxe against filing a plain return. Prices vary by tax year, so read the current pricing page.

Who stands behind it

FreeTaxUSA is owned by TaxHawk, Inc., and its products are described as backed by Sovos Compliance, LLC. The site publishes an Accuracy Guarantee: if a calculation error in the software leads to a penalty or interest from the IRS or a state, FreeTaxUSA says it will reimburse those amounts, subject to its terms.

When it may not fit

  • Very complicated situations, such as multi-state business income, may call for a tax professional.
  • It prepares United States returns only.
  • Check your state's own free-file programmes, which may cover a state return at no cost.

What we could not verify

We did not file a return. Fees are quoted from third-party reviews and change each season; the company's pricing page is authoritative. This article is general information, not tax advice.
